summary: Reuse runtime status and history membership while their input generations are unchanged

replay.detail: Graph admission and action replay are unchanged.

schema.detail: Database, projections and wire contracts are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Machine inventory and runtime publication folds retain per-subject runtime reductions and current/history membership across unrelated authored claims. Runtime harness output still invalidates on authored work.claimed and work.progress. Claims about the runtime or its owning run or generation still invalidate it. Historical snapshot cuts, caller authorization and non-runtime status modes are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon replacement applies the correction.

manual.detail: No configuration or migration is needed.

recovery.detail: Unchanged runtime inputs no longer trigger history reductions merely because an agent authored unrelated claims. Projection replacement, repair and conflict invalidation still discard cached reductions.
